revenue.formula: (latest quarter revenue / same fiscal quarter prior-year revenue − 1) × 100

momentum.formula: median(latest 4 quarterly YoY growth rates) − median(preceding 4), pp; ±3 pp thresholds

revenue_consistency.formula: max absolute second difference ≤ max(3 pp, 25% of median absolute growth); or sustained level shift (≥3 quarters each side)

operating_margin.formula: latest quarter operating income / same-quarter revenue × 100

operating_margin_trend.formula: latest quarter operating margin − same fiscal quarter prior-year operating margin, pp

fcf_margin.formula: (TTM operating cash flow − TTM capex) / TTM revenue × 100

forward_pe.notes: Expected EPS implied by the stored forward P/E and its reference price; not an independently verified analyst estimate.
forward_pe.formula: current price / sourced annual forward EPS
warnings: A positive sourced annual EPS estimate, identifiable forecast horizon, currency and estimate date are required; quote and estimate must be no older than seven days. Historical EPS extrapolation is excluded.

balance_sheet.formula: cash and cash equivalents − total debt; investments excluded
warnings: Net cash/debt requires unrestricted cash equivalents and complete compatible debt. Investments are excluded; inspect component definitions.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

short_term_investments.notes: short_term_investments: SEC companyfacts did not include a usable public fact.
warnings: Investment composition and liquidity require review; excluded from net cash.

long_term_investments.notes: long_term_investments: SEC companyfacts did not include a usable public fact.
warnings: Investment composition and liquidity require review; excluded from net cash.

debt.notes: Latest available SEC debt fact. This may include capital/finance lease obligations depending on the SEC tag.

upcoming_earnings.notes: Days until the next expected earnings release window (2026-11-17) from Yahoo Finance/yfinance. This is an open/free market-calendar estimate and can change before the company confirms the date.
upcoming_earnings.formula: source event/window start date − current date

red_flag_count.notes: Potential concerns, not an investment-quality rating. Incomplete assessments have no numeric screening value.
red_flag_count.formula: One point per distinct flagged concern group; overlapping rules within a group count once.
warnings: Assessment incomplete or not applicable; do not interpret this as zero red flags.

checks.title: Persistent earnings-to-cash gap
checks.formula: TTM net income > 0 and TTM operating cash flow < TTM net income at both of the latest two quarter ends
checks.reason: Operating cash flow compared with positive reported earnings over two consecutive rolling TTM periods; working capital and non-cash items require context.

checks.title: Persistent negative free cash flow
checks.formula: Sum(operating cash flow − abs(capex)) < 0 in each of the latest two non-overlapping four-quarter periods
checks.reason: Comparable, sourced quarterly inputs are missing, invalid or stale.

checks.title: Consecutive margin deterioration
checks.formula: Operating income / revenue is lower than the equivalent prior-year quarter in both latest quarters
checks.reason: Two consecutive year-over-year operating-margin comparisons; restructuring, investment and business mix can affect margins.

checks.title: Consecutive operating losses
checks.formula: Operating income < 0 in both latest quarters
checks.reason: Operating losses in consecutive quarters are a potential concern, including for businesses investing for growth.

checks.title: Negative book equity
checks.reason: Negative reported book equity; buybacks, distributions and accounting history can explain the deficit. This is not an insolvency finding.

checks.title: Priced for Perfection
checks.formula: Market cap / TTM revenue > 10 AND TTM (operating cash flow − abs(capex)) / same market cap < 0.02
checks.reason: Stock valuation is unusually high relative to current revenue and free cash flow generation. Initial screening heuristics, not universal valuation standards.

price_to_sales.formula: market capitalization / latest four reported quarters of revenue

fcf_yield.formula: sum(quarterly operating cash flow − abs(capex)) / same market capitalization × 100

screening.verification: Source identifiers preserve provenance; financial inputs have not been independently verified.
